translation: Use one croton seed (巴豆) not de-oiled, three blister beetles (斑蝥), and a little musk (麝香); mix with scallion juice and honey, knead into the shape of a wheat grain, wrap in silk floss, and place in the ear. The sound is like thunder; do not be alarmed or frightened. Wait twenty-one days, and when pus and water flow out of the ear, only then remove the suppository. It is wonderfully effective beyond compare.
